provenance.what: counts of finished items from the Craft of Exile emulator (Wraecrafter Ultra), our measurement; no Craft of Exile code
provenance.emulator: https://www.craftofexile.com/?game=poe1 , run headless from a local copy by tools/coe_emulator/record.py
provenance.seeded: driver.js seeds the page's Math.random (mulberry32); the same seed on the same copy repeats the counts

alteration-r13-belt.note: Orb of Alteration on a magic Leather Belt of item level 86 (R13's base)

augmentation-r13-belt.note: Orb of Augmentation on a magic Leather Belt of item level 86 that holds one suffix: it adds a prefix

exalt-j01-wants-attack-speed.note: #637: the Exalted Orb the J01 plan takes once the orb is added to the actions: key (run 42378616946). A rare Cobalt Jewel holding the goal's two prefixes (% increased maximum Life, Wand attack speed) and one filler suffix: both prefix slots are full (a jewel holds 2 and 2), so the orb adds a suffix, and the jewel is the target when it is (3-5)% increased Attack Speed. With the joint 'the target is met' count

exalt-j01-wants-life.note: #637: as above, the jewel holding the Wand attack speed prefix, the Attack Speed suffix and one filler suffix: only a prefix can be added, and the jewel is the target when it is the % increased maximum Life

exalt-j01-wants-wand-speed.note: #637: as above, the jewel holding the Life prefix, the Attack Speed suffix and one filler suffix: only a prefix can be added, and the jewel is the target when it is the Wand attack speed

exalt-v01-life-three-mods.note: #637: the plan's Exalted Orb on a helmet that holds the tier 1 Life and two filler suffixes, hoping for the +1 to Level of all Minion Skill Gems (weight 250 of the pool)

exalt-v01-minion-five-mods.note: #637: a full side: the helmet holds the +1 Minion mod, a filler prefix and three suffixes (a helmet holds 3 and 3), so the orb can add only a prefix, and the helmet is the target when it is the tier 1 Life. The cap on mods. The V01 plan with the orb added takes it on such helmets too (790 of its 1,360 Exalted Orb states hold five mods, envelope solver, 2026-11-13), though its likeliest path ends after the second orb on four

exalt-v01-minion-four-mods.note: #637: the plan's second Exalted Orb (Augmentation > Regal > Exalted > Exalted): a helmet holding the +1 Minion mod, one filler prefix and two filler suffixes, both sides open, and the helmet is the target when the orb adds the tier 1 Life. Fillers on both sides, so that one filler prefix is seen to cost the pool exactly its family

exalt-v01-minion-three-mods.note: #637: the Exalted Orb the V01 plan takes once the orb is added to the key (Augmentation > Regal > Exalted > Exalted, run 42378616946). A rare Lion Pelt of item level 84 holding the recipe's +1 to Level of all Minion Skill Gems and two filler suffixes: the orb adds one mod of either side, and the helmet is the target when it is the tier 1 Life. With the joint 'the target is met' count
